text_block_list.text:
This cheering is amazing... When you're
the one
running, the crowd sounds
completely different.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: It feels like everyone's hopes and dreams are out here today. I get it now... This is what the Derby is all about!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
A little bit. But I'm keeping myself in
check.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Look at me, running in a race like the
Derby...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
I feel a bit out of my element, but that's
not
going to slow me down.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Here, in the biggest race in Japan, I'm
going to
show everybody my
mind-blowing speed!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
You know I will! Root real loud for me,
okay?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски
